{{Quote|There is ''no one'' like me in the galaxy! I am justice! I am the bane of the Jedi! I haunt the dreams of their Padawans! I will drink your fear and spill your blood and my hate will scar the galaxy! I am Aurra Sing!|Aurra Sing|<ref name="SWRAS">''[[Jedi: Aayla Secura]]''</ref>}}
'''Aurra Sing''', also known as '''Nashtah''', was once a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] aspirant, but following a series of tragedies and misfortunes, she left the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to become a vicious [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] specializing in Jedi and political [[Assassin/Legends|assassinations]]. She even became an associate in the posse of [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], a brief mentor of the orphaned [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and later an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agent under the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], Sing was hired to kill [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]] and [[Chume'da]] [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]], only to be beaten by the latter.

Sing's career spanned over eight [[Standard decade|decades]], from before [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]] to [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
[[File:JediFamilyPortrait-SWR29.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Aurra Sing as a Padawan]]
Aurra Sing was born in the slums of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to a [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-addicted mother named [[Aunuanna]], who called the child "angel,"<ref name="Emissaries 5" /><ref name="CN:SOS" /> and a [[Aurra Sing's father/Legends|father]] she never knew.<ref name="CN:SOS" /> A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]], the young Sing was exposed to the ruthless violence of Nar Shaddaa for the first two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of her life, before her strength in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] was discovered by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]<ref name="NEGTC" /> [[The Dark Woman|An'ya Kuro]], also known as "the Dark Woman."<ref name="SWRAS" /> Promising Aunuana that her daughter would have a better life away from the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]],<ref name="Emissaries 5" /> the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] brought Sing to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where the Dark Woman, her one-time student [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], and other members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] the child to use the Force and the Jedi [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Mundi was troubled by the darkness in Sing,<ref name="NEGTC" /> and Kuro, though experienced with difficult students, was a harsh teacher, and struggled to form the bond with her pupil<ref name="SWRAS" /> that the Jedi Council had hoped would allow Sing to put aside her aggression and learn control. Headstrong and deadly, Sing was dubbed "Nashtah" by her fellow students, for a six-legged [[Dra III|Dravian]] [[Nashtah|predatory animal]].<ref name="DB" />

Not yet a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] apprentice,<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|aurrasing|Sing, Aurra}}</ref> Sing traveled with Kuro to a training ground maintained by the master on [[Ord Namurt]].<ref name="PotJ">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref> The nine-year-old student was led into a trap by a young [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], and captured by<ref name="NEGTC" /> [[Sennex]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Sing was convinced by the pirates that her master had sold her to them as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]],<ref name="Song">{{StoryCite|story=Aurra's Song|book=Dark Horse Presents Annual 2000: Girls Rule!}}</ref> while the Dark Woman suspected that her apprentice had left to escape her arduous training,<ref name="PotJ" /> and deemed her departure to be the will of the Force.<ref name="SWRAS" /> Sing joined the pirate crew and learned to track and ambush quarry from its [[Captain/Legends|captain]], who, years later, sold her to [[Wallanooga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] for several thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], having grown jealous of her skill and fearing that she would usurp his power.<ref name="NEGTC" />

Once again on Nar Shaddaa, Sing underwent further training at the expense of her Hutt masters, depleting a generation's worth of the wealth accumulated by the family of [[Urdruua]] the Hutt.<ref name="CWA:OS">{{CWACite|8|Old Scores}}</ref> Seeking to translate Sing's Force-sensitivity and [[The fringe|fringe]]-honed skills into a career as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], Sing's new master apprenticed her to an academy of [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] killers who [[Cybernetics/Legends|implanted]] her skull with a [[Rhen-Orm/Legends|Rhen-Orm]] [[Biocomputer/Legends|biocomputer]] sensor.<ref name="DB" /> With a personal debt to Wallanooga compelling Anzati leader [[Anis]] to ignore the his people's reluctance to train outsiders and protecting Sing from harm, she learned the four cornerstones of assassination&mdash;the kill, infiltration, drama, and evasion&mdash;from instructor [[Torgo Tahn]], whose obsessive advances she continually rebuffed.<ref name="Song" /> After four years, Sing's education was complete, and she set out to exact revenge on those who had wronged her in the past, killing Wallanooga and the pirate crew.<ref name="NEGTC" />

===Jedi hunter===
====Early victims====
{{Quote|Fear me, Jedi! I am Aurra Sing, Nashtah, scourge of your kind! I haunt your darkest dreams! I drink Jedi blood; I nest in their guts! Your nightmares now have a name, hierophant, and that name is Aurra Sing!|Aurra Sing|<ref name="CN:SOS" />}}
Before [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]], Aurra Sing began a career as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and assassin, with Jedi among the number of her victims. Sing gained a reputation among the Order for claiming the lightsabers of her quarry as trophies.<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> Though Sing refused to join the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]], its [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Guild Master/Legends|guildmaster]] [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]] would employ her services in the capture or killing of hunters who violated guild rules.<ref name="BHAS">''[[The Bounty Hunters: Aurra Sing]]''</ref>

During [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] apprenticeship to Jedi Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], Sing hunted the Jedi [[Mana Veridi]] on [[Kwannot]]. Veridi, underestimated by the assassin, was able to communicate a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress call]] to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], who dispatched Kenobi and Jinn to her aid. As the two arrived and made contact with Veridi in a darkened alleyway, Sing [[Death/Legends|killed]] her and engaged the rescuers in a [[Duel on Kwannot|lightsaber duel]]. Outfighting Kenobi, the bounty hunter pursued Jinn to a nearby rooftop and took the master by surprise by drawing a second blade. When the apprentice rejoined the battle, Sing knocked both Jedi to the ground, but found herself outmatched in combat and fled, though she was able to claim Veridi's lightsaber for her collection.<ref name="OB">{{Tales|12|Once Bitten}}</ref>

Around [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="SongDate">According to ''[[Star Wars Omnibus: Rise of the Sith]]'', ''[[Aurra's Song]]'' takes place approximately 36 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], 36 years after [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].</ref> Sing put into action a scheme to capture Torgo Tahn and claim a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his head: the [[37 BBY/Legends|year prior]], the bounty hunter had purchased a [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]], which she modified with onboard [[energy inverter]]s and arranged for an agent to sell to Tahn. Posting a price on her own head as a lure, Sing sprung a trap set for her by the Anzati, following a faked message from the Dark Woman and staged opposition from the [[Nuala Marauders/Legends|Nuala Marauders]] to the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] she had prepared, where she was captured and restrained by Tahn. As he debated whether he would claim the bounty or kill her himself, Sing activated the inverters, freeing herself, turning her restraints on her captor, and taking him prisoner.<ref name="Song" />

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during her time on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Sing watched the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]] from a balcony on [[Beggar's Canyon/Legends|Beggar's Canyon]].<ref name="TPM" /> She noticed that the young [[Human/Legends|Human]] slave, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], was not cheating, which was astounding to her. She had reasoned that it was because of his strong connection to the Force that helped the boy win "an honest race in a contest that has no rules."<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref> At the same time, Skywalker won his freedom.<ref name="TPM" /> They would formally meet a [[22 BBY/Legends|decade]] later.<ref name="New Droid Army">''[[Star Wars: The New Droid Army]]''</ref>

Jedi Knight and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] instructor [[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]] cited the threat of the saber-wielding Sing as cause for the sustained study of [[Form II]], a dueling style oriented towards saber-to-saber combat, in a discussion of lightsaber forms recorded in the Jedi Order's [[Great Holocron/Legends|Great Holocron]] in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].<ref name="JvS" />

====The hunt for Aurra Sing====
[[File:Aurra_sing_ep1.png|thumb|220px|Aurra Sing at the Boonta Eve Classic Podrace in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].]]
Sing became known as a hunter of Jedi, carving a bloody swath of victims including [[Sharad Hett]] on Tatooine,<ref name="O">''[[Star Wars: Outlander]]''</ref> and [[Peerce]] and [[J'Mikel]] on Coruscant. After the deaths of Peerce, J'Mikel and a group of [[Republic Peace Officer]]s, J'Mikel's Padawan [[Xiaan Amersu]] described the [[Duel on Coruscant (30 BBY)|attack]] to the Council. The Council then decided to send Ki-Adi-Mundi, [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], and [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] to begin a [[Hunt for Aurra Sing|hunt]] for Sing. Sing was soon brought to the planet [[Talas]] where she was attacked by [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] dispatched by two [[Quarren/Legends|Quarrens]] named [[Tallet]] and [[Lekket]]. The Quarrens explained to Sing that they needed her services to assassinate the Quarren Senator [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]], who had tipped off the Republic on an operation the Quarrens had been running. Sing took no interest in the senator but agreed to the mission anyway after finding out that her former master, the Dark Woman, led the raid. Sing was nearly captured by the Jedi hunting her, but escaped aboard a personal flier. After crashing on a lush jungle world, Sing engaged the Jedi protecting Tikkes. Sing managed to get aboard the ship holding the Senator with only Hett guarding him. Sing and Hett dueled with their lightsabers with Hett coming out as the victor. Sing soon escaped, however, as the Jedi and the Senator left the planet.<ref name="HFAS" />

====Later contracts====
In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="DHCT">According to {{DarkHorse|url=Zones/StarWars/Timeline|text=Comics Timeline}}, ''[[The Bounty Hunters: Aurra Sing]]'' takes place 27 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before {{Film|IV}}, which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], 27 years after [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> Sing was contacted through the Bounty Hunters' Guild by [[Reess Kairn]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] former Jedi and pirate who had assumed the identity of a [[Priest/Legends|priestess]] of the [[Order of the Ffib]] through [[Reconstructive surgery/Legends|reconstructive surgery]]. On the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] of the planet [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]], Kairn hired Sing to kill three [[Shi'ido]] members of his crew, who had used their [[Species/Legends|species']] [[Changeling/Legends|shape-shifting abilities]] to take on the Twi'lek's original appearance. Kairn directed the hunter to three planets representing elemental states&mdash;Icy [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] for liquid, [[Desert/Legends|desert]] Tatooine for flame, and gaseous [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] for sky&mdash;and claimed that one of three was himself, identifiable by the red-colored eyes of a spice addict. In reality, the hunt was a ruse conceived to fake his own death, and he had hired [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Thranta Rider]]s to kill Sing over Bespin.<ref name="BHAS" />

On Hoth, she disguised herself in the pelt of a [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] controlled by the Shi'ido via biostim implant to infiltrate his camp and confront him. In the ensuing [[lightfight]], Sing killed the impostor and caused a cave-in, before escaping the Shi'ido's wampas and a [[dragon slug]] awoken by the collapse with a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]]. Proceeding to Tatooine, she took up a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper's]] position in the [[City/Legends|township]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] and shot the second Shi'ido while he drove a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] with [[Wuher/Legends|Wuher]], a young human, onboard. Believing she had killed the last of the impostors, Sing traveled to Bespin and pursued her target, observing an aerial [[Acrobat/Legends|acrobatics]] display from the back of a [[Thranta/Legends|thranta]], on an [[airhook]], only to be set upon by Kairn's mercenaries. The hunter killed her assailants and commandeered a thranta, while abandoning her airhook to collide with and kill "Reess Kairn." Recovering his corpse, Sing discovered, to her surprise, that he had been in reality the third Shi'ido. Realising that she had been betrayed to the mercenaries and deceived about Kairn's whereabouts, Sing reasoned that the fourth elemental state, land, corresponded to the Endor moon. Returning to the place her hunt had begun, she approached the "priestess" from behind, and shot and killed the genuine Kairn.<ref name="BHAS" />

On [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], Sing ran into [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars Adventures 6: The Warlords of Balmorra]]''</ref> a fellow bounty hunter for whom she had worked as a contract stringer,<ref name="NEGTC" /> while hunting [[Rigorra]] the Hutt. Aurra apparently had had a connection to the Hutt when she was just a slave to Wallanooga. Sing and Fett managed to infiltrate the Hutt's well defended palace but were captured along with two other bounty hunters&mdash;[[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and [[Skorr/Legends|Skorr]]&mdash;who were hunting [[Groodo|Rigorra's brother]]. All four managed to escape after being poisoned with powerful toxic flowers and Sing captured Rigorra.<ref name=":0" />

===Clone Wars===
====Separatist employment====
{{Quote|Hello, Aurra. What a surprise to find you here."<br />"I'm sure. You shouldn't have come here, Jedi, but I will enjoy watching you die."<br />"Sorry to have to disappoint you.|Sing prepares to fight Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="New Droid Army" />}}
[[File:Aurra-assassin.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Aurra Sing on Devaron during the Clone Wars.]]
Sing was employed for a time by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], who sent her to find [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], as the boy was thought to have information vital to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] cause. Upon discovering that young Fett was heir to a large amount of money, Sing attempted to take the money herself.<ref name="SW: UVG: U & E">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> This plan failed, however, when the young Fett escaped her on [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]].<ref name="Boba Fett: Maze of Deception">''[[Boba Fett: Maze of Deception]]''</ref>

In 22 BBY,<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Sing was hired by the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Vien'sai'Malloc]] to assassinate her colleague, Senator [[Elsah'sai'Moro]], who threatened to reveal Sai'Malloc's arrangement with the Separatists to establish a raiding base on the planet [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. Sing crossed paths with Jedi sent to investigate Sai'Moro's death, including [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]], and An'ya Kuro. She almost killed the latter two in a cave explosion but was defeated and captured instead by Secura, who scarred the bounty hunter and sliced off her bio-computer antenna. Sing was sent to a prison on [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]],<ref name="SWRAS" /> but secured her release with information pertaining to bounties posted on the Jedi<ref name="NEC" /> by the [[Crimson Nova]] chapter of the Bounty Hunters' Guild,<ref name="Rep65">[[Republic 65|''Republic'' 65]]</ref> of which she was a one-time member by the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].<ref name="TFUCG" />

During the [[C-B3 cortosis battle droid/Legends|Cortosis droid]] crisis, Anakin Skywalker encountered Sing on Tatooine. She first posed as one of the locals, and asked the young Jedi's help in eliminating a [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rat]] nest that was harassing the inhabitants. To her surprise, Skywalker managed to solve the problem without any incident. She revealed herself, and temporarily distracted him, by setting off a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]]. Skywalker chased after the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and cornered her near [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the Hutt's [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]]. However, before they could fight, [[Saato]] managed to incapacitate Anakin, and ordered Sing to throw the Padawan into the palace dungeons.<ref name="New Droid Army" />

Three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], Urdruua the Hutt placed a death mark on a Jedi and Sing accepted the bounty. However, the Hutt revealed that the Jedi Aurra was supposed to be hunting was in fact herself. He shot poison gas into his main chamber, but Sing escaped, to find herself surrounded by Nikto assassins being led by a [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] with a nail gun. After finding another way to escape, she sniped out three [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] assassins, who were also trying to snipe her. After getting on a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] with the Hutt, she noted that she had placed a bomb in the Hutt's palace, and a few seconds later it was destroyed. Aurra Sing left the scene saying: "Such a waste. Now I have to go to find real Jedi to kill."<ref name="CWA:OS" />

During Separatist-aligned bounty hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cade Bane's]] [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|mission]] to capture Republic [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]] on Devaron, Aurra Sing was hired by her fellow hunter to lead [[Nashtah Team]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. Confirming their target's position, Sing ordered a [[Unidentified B2-HA super battle droid (Devaron)|droid subordinate]]&mdash;who mistook her for Separatist [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]&mdash;to fire on a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Republic gunship]] to provide a distraction for Bane's attack.<ref name="AoI" />

====Joining Boba Fett====
{{Quote|Only two to go, Windu. Come and find us. We'll be waiting!|Aurra Sing to Mace Windu via hologram|<ref name="Bounty Hunter: Boba Fett">''[[The Clone Wars: Bounty Hunter: Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
[[File:AurraBoba-TCW.png|thumb|right|160px|Aurra Sing and Boba Fett]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="TCWDate">{{FactFile2014|35|21 BBY 9-12|Boba Fett's Revenge}}</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she joined up with Boba Fett to [[Sabotage of the Endurance/Legends|kill]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] for revenge for Boba's father. Boba, under the name of "Lucky", boarded the [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']] as a [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadet]]. After his first attempt on Windu's life failed, he contacted Sing to ask for advice. Sing told him to blow up the reactors, much to Boba's surprise. After Boba successfully destroyed the ''Endurance's'' reactors, sending it crashing towards [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]], he got into one of the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] along with several of the other cadets. Once they were away from the plummeting vessel, the pod was docked by [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']]. Bossk and Sing entered the pod to confront Boba. After telling him that the other cadets must be launched into space, due to the fact that they are "living witnesses", Boba reluctantly came aboard ''Slave I'' and jettisoned the pod from ''Slave I's'' docking area. Although the group of bounty hunters escaped, the cadets were saved by Anakin Skywalker and Windu, who had escaped the ''Endurance'' in their [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Jedi Starfighters]].<ref name="Death Trap">{{TCW|Death Trap}}</ref>

She later abducted Admiral [[Shoan Kilian/Legends|Kilian]], [[Ponds/Legends|Commander Ponds]], and a [[Unidentified clone navigation officer (Endurance)/Legends|naval officer]] from the crash site of the ''Endurance'' on Vanqor. After Skywalker and Windu triggered their bomb in the crash site, Boba convinced Sing to go back there and get the two Jedis' heads to bring to Dooku, who might pay them for their trouble. Sing, along with Boba and Castas, went to the crash site. Due to the ship falling apart, and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2's]] interference, Sing decided to blow up the crash site. As they left, Bossk contacted Sing, telling that a explosion happened near where the Jedi landed. Sing then ordered Bossk to jam all transmissions from the planet. When Sing and her team returned to ''Slave I'', they saw [[Mace Windu's Jedi fighter/Legends|Windu's Jedi starfighter]] taking off. Unbeknownst to Sing, only R2-D2 was aboard. Though ''Slave I'' took out the Jedi fighter's communications, Artoo reached the [[Syliure-31 hyperspace docking ring/Legends|hyperspace rings]] and escaped. Knowing that Windu would not hold a grudge against them, she decided to motivate Windu by using the hostages.<ref name="R2 come home">{{TCW|R2 Come Home}}</ref>

When contacting Mace Windu to come and find her, Sing shot Ponds, whom she had abducted, after Boba wouldn't do it. The group of bounty hunters then docked on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] for a visit with Sing's old flame [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] to see if he would give them any advice. During a visit in the bar with Hondo, Sing overheard [[Castas/Legends|Castas]] communicating via hologram to a [[Fong Do/Legends|friend]] on Coruscant. After hearing him calling her an old hag, she shot him. [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] later caught up with her. After having a quarrel in a room, Sing fled away, leaving a discouraged Boba behind. Tano chased her, but after getting an order from Plo Koon, she went to free the hostages. Sing got suspicious, so she went to go and stop the Padawan. After Tano pursued her, she fled on ''Slave I'', but because of a wing failure caused by Tano, the ship crashed. Sing was presumed dead by the Jedi.<ref name="Lethal Trackdown">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> Unknown to them, Hondo salvaged her out of ''Slave I''{{'s}} wreckage.<ref name="Assassin">{{TCW|Assassin (episode)}}</ref>

====Blaster-for-hire====
{{Quote|Honey, this isn't about your cause. This is about revenge. My employer wants to get even with you. Simple as that.|Aurra Sing|<ref name="Assassin" />}}
[[File:AurraSing-Assassin.png|thumb|left|220px|Sing faces Ahsoka Tano, who is protecting Amidala]]
Sing was later hired by [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro the Hutt]] to assassinate Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in retaliation for imprisoning him. She tracked the Senator to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where Amidala was due for a [[Alderaan Conference on the Clone War Refugee Crisis|conference]] on refugee concerns. Infiltrating the conference through the vents and snapping the neck of several [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]], Sing set up a sniper position. Only the timely intervention of Tano gave Amidala a flesh wound, forcing Sing to flee.<ref name="Assassin" />

Sing later made a second attempt on Amidala's life when she tracked down the Senator, not being fooled by the [[Unidentified BD-3000 luxury droid|BD-3000 luxury droid]] acting in her place. But once again, Tano interfered. Sing outdrew Tano as she grazed the Padawan, but Amidala used a [[Stun blaster/Legends|stun blaster]] on her. Sing was then arrested and brought to Coruscant.<ref name="Assassin" />

[[File:Aura_Cad_Bane.png|thumb|right|200px|Sing teams up with Cad Bane]]
Later in the Clone Wars, Sing teamed up with Cad Bane's bounty hunter team for the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|raid]] on the Republic [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. To see how "solitary types" like Aurra Sing, [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]] and [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]] would work together, Bane set them on a test mission to capture bounty hunter [[Davtokk]] on the planet [[Keyorin]]. Davtokk attempted to take out Bane to collect the bounty on his head, but was overcome with relative ease by Bane's team. Pleased with their performance, Bane moved the team to Coruscant to prepare for an operation to rescue Ziro Desilijic Tiure.<ref name="Invitation Only">''[[The Clone Wars: Invitation Only]]''</ref>

During the hostage siege Aurra covered Bane's entrance to the building by taking out the Senate Commandos who attempted to stop him with a [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]]. After Bane eliminated the remaining Senate Commandos, Aurra shot a dying one. Later she aided Shahan Alama in searching for the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker, whose presence in the Senate Building threatened to thwart Bane's plan. Eventually, with the help of Robonino they managed to render Skywalker unconscious. When the Hutt crime lord was freed, Aurra Sing successfully left the crime scene along with the rest of the group.<ref name="TCW:HS">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref> Her actions earned her a one-hundred fifty thousand credit bounty on her head for "crimes against the Republic."<ref name="Wanted">{{SWArchive|url=media/kids/tcw/cwbountyhunters.pdf|text=Get Ready for ''The Clone Wars'' with Downloadable Goodies}}</ref>

During the Clone Wars, Sing was hired to [[Assassination attempt on Yong Dolor|assassinate]] Republic [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] [[Yong Dolor]] on Coruscant by his assistant [[Lorn (aide)|Lorn]], who hoped to pin the incident on the Separatists and take his superior's place. From a sniper's position, she took aim at the ambassador, but was interrupted by Jedi Knight [[Jyl Somtay]]. Though Somtay disarmed and captured Sing, turning her over to [[GU-series Guardian police droid/Legends|GU-series "Guardian" police droids]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]], she was unable to uncover Lorn's identity. To do so, the Jedi Knight disguised herself as Sing and, tracing a [[Poison/Legends|poison]] found on a [[Ryyk blade/Legends|ryyk blade]] carried by the bounty hunter to a [[Unidentified Coruscant dive|dive bar]], and confronted her [[Unidentified dive owner|contact]] on the pretense of demanding upfront payment. At the same time, the genuine Sing feigned asphyxiation in Republic custody, prompting the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to release her restraints and allowing her to escape. Pursuing the impostor to the bar and attacking her, Sing was again defeated by Somtay and rendered unconscious. Still posing as Sing, Somtay had the contact arrange a meeting with Lorn and goaded him into confessing his guilt before arresting them both, foiling their plot.<ref name="Masq">{{TCWComicCite|6.28|Jedi Masquerade}}</ref>

===Agent of the Empire===
[[File:AurraSing_Unleashed.jpg|left|thumb|Aurra Sing unleashed.]]
In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], she was freed by Darth Vader and sent to kill the former Jedi, [[Jax Pavan]]. Vader had her transported to Coruscant, and she went to the remains of the Jedi Temple to search for any clues to Pavan's whereabouts. While there, she encountered [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] and in the resulting [[Skirmish in the Jedi Temple|duel]] between them, she lost and became unconscious. Typho then took one of her lightsabers, which he would later send as a gift to Jax.<ref name="CN:SOS" />

Sing was closing in on her quarry, getting nearer and nearer to finding Jax, and at one point engaged in a duel against Jax's [[Gray Paladin]] ally, [[Laranth Tarak]]. Later, she caught up with Pavan and engaged him in a duel. The Jedi outsmarted Sing, and dropped her into a reposticator, where he presumed Sing met her death.<ref name="CN:SOS" />

===Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|Jedi assassin?! Look, I ain't the biggest believer in all that kooky mysticism, but even I know that Jedi don't die easy.|Han Solo|<ref name="OB" />}}
En route from Tatooine's [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] to the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]] aboard the [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the aged Obi-Wan Kenobi shared the tale of his and his master's encounter with Sing on Kwannot with the ''Falcon''{{'s}} captain, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. Unfamiliar with the hunter, Solo was incredulous at the success of a Jedi-targeting assassin, and at Kenobi's claim that Sing had fled with her opponents at her mercy.<ref name="OB" />

[[File:Aurra_Sing_Demolition.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Aurra Sing participating in Jabba's demolition games]]
Sing was seen again on Tatooine soon after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], once again on the hunt of a Jedi. She had followed her instincts to the planet as she had sensed a new Force wielder there, but was unable to pick out her target at first as his powers hadn't yet surfaced and so she was unsure as to who it was. To find out, she entered [[Jabba's demolition games]] on her ancient swoop, using her sniper rifle to take out targets. She eventually discovered that that her target was the young [[Wade Vox]], whom she tried to take out after he won his freedom. She was unable to do so, however, as Vox deflected her sniper shots with his newly-built crimson lightsaber.<ref name="Demolition">''[[Star Wars: Demolition]]''</ref>

===Galactic Alliance===
{{Quote|Your father was full of surprises as you are.|Aurra Sing to Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="Tempest" />}}
{{Expandsect}}
[[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[Historical Council]] [[Archivist emeritus]] [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] reported Sing's killing of Sharad Hett, her Coruscant massacre and subsequent pursuit&mdash;with an attached image of her duel with A'Sharad Hett&mdash;and her role in the Devaron ruse and [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] crisis of the Clone Wars, in his [[36 ABY]] chronicle [[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|''The New Essential Chronology'']].<ref name="NEC" />

[[File:Aurra_Sing_EGTF.jpg|thumb|left|200px|An image of Aurra Sing included in ''Jedi vs. Sith'']]
In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]],<ref name="LotFDate">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]'' to [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].</ref> using the name "Nashtah," Sing was accidentally hired by [[Lalu Morwan]] to assassinate [[Hapan]] [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]] and her young daughter [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]]. After allying herself with an undercover Han and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], whom she shared her tale of watching Anakin Skywalker's race, her attempt to kill Allana was thwarted by [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and ironically, her own quarry; while she managed to destroy the [[Defender Droid]] [[DD-11A]] and deal a few wounds on Solo, she had suffered a dislocated knee and was immobilized by Allana's [[injector pen]]. Soon afterward, she was captured by security forces and placed in a holding cell aboard the Star Destroyer [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']].<ref name="Tempest" />

In the same year, after the [[Skirmish on Kavan|death]] of Jedi Master [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], Cin Drallig's remarks on Sing were recovered from the Great Holocron and compiled by [[New Jedi Order]] archivist [[Tionne Solusar]], along with an image and description of the bounty hunter, in the historical record ''[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force]]''.<ref name="JvS" />

Around [[138 ABY]],<ref name="WarDate">[[Legacy — War 1|''Legacy — War'' 1]] takes place approximately 138 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], 138 years before [[138 ABY]].</ref> a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] of Sing killing the elder Hett was conjured by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]] during a [[Assault on the Temple of the Sith|duel]] with the younger, now known by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] title Darth Krayt.<ref name="War">[[Legacy — War 1|''Legacy — War'' 1]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Aurra_Sing_SWFB.png|thumb|right|180px|Aurra Sing, assassin for hire]]
{{Quote|I never ask for permission to do anything, my darling.|Aurra Sing, to Hondo Ohnaka|<ref name="Lethal Trackdown" />}}
Aurra Sing was one of the most powerful and ruthless bounty hunters in the galaxy. She possessed a great hatred of Jedi, believing that they had abandoned her. Because of this she was an angry and pained individual and Aayla Secura took advantage of this by taunting her about being abandoned by the Jedi Order, allowing her to defeat Sing. Sing had no qualms about committing murder and killed Clone Commander Ponds without a second thought. During her youth, she was also noted for being very aggressive, and therefore the Jedi Council placed her under the instruction of An'ya Kuro. However, Sing hated Kuro, possibly because she used brutal and, to some, disturbing training methods, and she quickly believed that the Jedi Master had abandoned her when she was captured by pirates and thus turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].

Sing avoided live bounties due to their heightened difficulty and expense, fulfilling them only at a premium to her employer.<ref name="BHAS" /> When the contract called for it, however, she could put aside her personal feelings and take a target in alive.<ref name="Song" />

However, despite her ruthlessness, Sing was also somewhat of a mother to Boba Fett during his teenage years, sometimes addressing him as "honey" and stopping him from drinking alcohol in Hondo Ohnaka's bar. She was, however, also very selfish and abandoned Fett to save herself after the boy was captured by Plo Koon. She also tried to get the boy to murder the helpless Commander Ponds and, when he hesitated, she simply shoved him aside and killed Ponds herself.

Boba's bounty hunter father, Jango, felt sympathy for Aurra. Over the years, Jango Fett had encountered many other bounty hunters and, on several occasions, had even been required to kill them. He'd done so without remorse because bounty hunting was, after all, a chosen profession, and everyone knew the risks. No one had, by [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], ever gained Jango's entire trust, and very few&mdash;only [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] and Cradossk&mdash;had ever earned his respect. But ever since his first run-in with Sing, he'd felt something for her that was&mdash;for Jango&mdash;even more powerful than trust or respect: she had his sympathy, something Fett kept in extremely short supply. While others looked at Aurra and saw nothing more than a trigger-happy [[Psychopathy|psychopath]], Jango saw her as a broken spirit, the result of a lifetime of bad breaks. He felt sympathy for Aurra because she had not chosen bounty hunting as a profession, it had chosen her.<ref name=":0" />

Aurra Sing had, for a time, a romantic relationship with Hondo Ohnaka, and though they were no longer lovers by the time of the Clone Wars, Ohnaka still referred to her as "my dear". However, Ohnaka refused to help Sing when she tried to lure Ahsoka Tano and Plo Koon into a trap.

===Parentage===
{{Quote|My mother was human. My father was a ghost in the night, and I doubt even my mother knew his species&mdash;but it was obviously a long-lived one. If I ever find out who he was, perhaps I'll be able to hunt him down and kill him.|Aurra Sing|<ref name="Tempest" />}}
[[File:Aurra_Sing_takes_aim.png|thumb|left|250px|Aurra Sing's long fingers]]

Sing's biological heritage was veiled in secrecy. Her mother was Human, but her father was of an unknown long-lived species. Nevertheless, rumors abounded, some even speculating that he may have been Anzati.<ref name="CN:SOS" />

She inherited certain physical traits from her father, such as her pale white skin, dark and sunken eye sockets, and fingers roughly twice the length of the standard Human hand, having an extra phalanx.<ref name="NEGTC" /> Another trait that seemed to originate from her father was a very strange metabolism which required her to frequently ingest sustenance, which mainly consisted of drinking blood drained from raw meat. She also inherited his longevity, her life having long exceeded that of a regular Human. At the time of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], she was at least ninety years old though she appeared no older than she had during the Clone Wars, sixty years prior.<ref name="Tempest" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Truly, her powers are great. The dark side must be strong in her."<br />"No&mdash;not yet. I met her on Tatooine, remember&mdash;I don't know why, or how, but she neither a disciple of the light or the dark side.|[[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] and Ki-Adi-Mundi debate on Aurra Sing's Force allegiance|<ref name="SW28">[[Star Wars (1998) 28|''Star Wars'' (1998) 28]]</ref>
}}
[[File:AurraSing-swrep29.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Aurra Sing dodges droidekas with Force speed.]]
Aurra Sing was a deadly bounty hunter and Jedi killer who slew several Jedi throughout her career, including the highly skilled Sharad Hett. She was skilled in the use of telekinesis which she used to hurl rocks at Hett before killing him.<ref name="O" /> When ambushed by droidekas, she managed to evade their blaster bolts with [[Force speed/Legends|Force speed]] and use [[Force jump/Legends|Force Jump]] to get a close swipe at them. Sing was also a highly skilled lightsaber duelist, both with a single lightsaber and [[Jar'Kai/Legends|dual blades]].<ref name="HFAS" /> She was capable of utilizing [[Battlemind]] and [[Force sight]].<ref name="Dark Side Sourcebook">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref> Sing once employed Force lightning.<ref name="SW29">[[Star Wars (1998) 29|''Star Wars'' (1998) 29]]</ref>

Sing also proved to be an excellent markswoman and sniper, managing to shoot Sharad Hett in the arm on Tatooine.<ref name="O" /> She was also able to shoot down several Senate Commandos with great accuracy during her mission to rescue Ziro the Hutt and shot a blaster out of Anakin Skywalker's hand after he disarmed her companion, Shahan Alama.<ref name="TCW:HS" />

==Weapons and equipment==
{{Quote|I thought only the Jedi possessed such weapons!|Reess Kairn, on Aurra Sing's lightsaber|<ref name="BHAS" />}}
[[File:AurraSingBlaster-FF.png|thumb|left|250px|One of Sing's dual-trigger blaster pistols]]
Aurra Sing often took Jedi's lightsabers as trophies and kept them in suitcases. She wielded two [[DX-13 blaster pistol/Legends|dual-triggered]] [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] and a [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] [[Adventurer slugthrower rifle/Legends|Adventurer slugthrower rifle]] or [[Fallann hyper-rifle]] slung on her back, as well as the lightsabers of the Jedi she had slain. She also made use of a [[Swoop/Legends|customized]] [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] while hunting Sharad Hett on Tatooine.

After killing the pirate crew who had sold her to Wallanooga the Hutt, Sing claimed their [[Aurra Sing's blockade runner|blockade runner]] as her own,<ref name="NEGTC" /> and berthed a [[Aurra Sing's starfighter|starfighter]] onboard.<ref name="SW29" /> In addition to her swoop bike, she employed a jetpack and airhook for transport during her hunt for Reess Kairn.<ref name="BHAS" />

[[File:Aurra_Sing_Menace.jpg|thumb|Aurra Sing's lightsaber]]
Sing had a number of [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] parts, the most prominent being the antenna sticking out of her head. Her skull contained a Rhen-Orm biocomputer, which could identify lifeforms,<ref name="BHAS" /> heighten her senses, and allow her to simulate the Anzati ability to perceive fear.<ref name="DB" /> Aurra Sing also possessed a scarlet single-bladed [[Aurra Sing's lightsaber|lightsaber]]. Sing didn't construct the lightsaber herself, but took it from one of the Jedi she killed. Prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], Sing used it to kill Jedi Knight Mana Veridi on the planet Kwannot and later wielded it in combat against Qui-Gon Jinn and his Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi. In 27 BBY, Sing carried her lightsaber while on the search for the rogue Jedi Reess Kairn.

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Aurra Sing was first conceived in a sketch labeled "Babe Fett" by [[Lucasfilm]]'s [[Doug Chiang]]. Chiang had made the sketch as a result of [[George Lucas]]' request to have more characters fill out the podracing sequence in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. In the final film, the character was played by model [[Michonne Bourriague]].<ref name="CSWE">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> Aurra Sing became so popular with fans that she was explored in other media, including the video games ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Demolition]]'' (where she was voiced by [[Tasia Valenza]]) and the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' TV series, where she was voiced by [[Jaime King]].

According to Aurra Sing's entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', Sing was 75 years old<ref name="CSWEAS">{{CSWECite|III|152&ndash;153|Sing, Aurra}}</ref> in 40 ABY,<ref name="LotFDate" /> approximately 76 years after her earliest known appearance,<ref name="SongDate" /> by which time she was over 13 years old according to ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''.<ref name="NEGTC" /> This article treats the age given by the ''Encyclopedia'' as an error.

Before the cancellation of ''The Clone Wars'', several unfinished episodes featuring Sing were written for the show's [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]], including one in which Sing was planned to be killed, according to King's husband Kyle Newman.<ref name="Aurra's Planned Death">{{YouTube|video=DU6WwLoQaqs|text=Solo Live Reaction|channel=channel/UCxnEDVUZe8-j61nKo4HzOYg|name=Steele Wars|quote=You know, she actually died befo... There were episodes of The Clone Wars season 6 that I was in, which were deleted and she was in that too and she died.}}</ref> Had this concept been [[canon]]ized, it would have contradicted Sing's appearances in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] stories set during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and the [[New Republic era|New Republic]] and [[New Jedi Order era]]s.<ref name="CN:SOS" /><ref name="Demolition" /><ref name="Tempest" />
